name: Summon Minion I
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level wizard 1

DESCRIPTION

As summon monster I, but it summons npcs from the Gamemastery Guide that have a CR at least 1 lower than creatures summon monster I would produce.

The same rules can be used to create summon minion II – IX, based on summon monster II – IX.
